d:
A fresh encounter broke out in Jammu and Kashmir's Kulgam district as security forces continued operations against terrorists linked to last week's attack on a CRPF post.
The renewed exchange of fire comes days after security forces killed Umar Nisar Dar, an accused in the attack that injured three CRPF personnel. Officials say the search is now focused on tracking down Mohammad Lateef Bhat, who allegedly escaped an earlier cordon during anti-terror operations in the district.
Thank you for watching our video!
